results.title: Mariinka
results.overview: In Eastern Ukraine, childhood neighbors find their lives violently derailed by a shifting frontline. Natasha, a promising boxing talent, becomes a military paramedic. Angela, who lost her parents at a young age, survives by moving goods to both sides of the front. Caught in a modern Greek tragedy, brothers Mark and Ruslan now fight on opposite sides – against each other. In the safety of his adoptive family in the United States, their youngest brother Daniil follows the war from afar.

results.title: I dreamed I was playing the drums
results.overview: Antonio, stubbornly clinging to his dreams, recounts his aspirations amidst black and white streets and colorful memories, while discovering why dreamers prefer to sleep rather than be awake.

results.title: Still Sexy
results.overview: Maddalena has it all: a job she loves, the perfect fiancé, and a dream wedding ahead. Yet in the bedroom, something feels wrong. Urged on by her inner voice, embodied by pornstar Valentina Nappi, she begins to question her life. Meeting Bruno, a gardener with a troubled past, leads her to rediscover herself and realize the only path worth following is her own.

results.title: Judge
results.overview: Based on the film Anna's Sin (1953).

results.title: Gorgeous Grandmother
results.overview: An aged beautician longing for confidence joins a beauty pageant.

results.title: Broken Years
results.overview: In the shadow of the 1975 embargo, theater actor Aytekin unwittingly becomes the star of the erotic film craze while trying to protect his family.

results.title: Jeff Ross: Take a Banana for the Ride
results.original_title: Jeff Ross: Take a Banana for the Ride
results.overview: Making his Broadway debut, legendary comic Jeff Ross turns the spotlight on himself in a one-man show that is as heartfelt as it is hilarious.

results.title: DAU
results.overview: Inspired by the physicists who built the Soviet atomic bomb, the film DAU follows a brilliant Greek-born physicist from 1928 through four tumultuous decades in the USSR. Driven to uncover the laws of the universe, the idealistic Dau is drawn into state service to help create one of history’s deadliest weapons. Inside a secret research institute, life is governed by scientific ambition, power, surveillance and privilege. As his autonomy erodes, Dau seeks freedom beyond his marriage through a succession of affairs, gradually losing both himself and his capacity to love. At once an intimate portrait of a man in pursuit of happiness and freedom and a vast fresco of a society founded on violence and ideology, DAU traces the small compromises that shape a life and alter the course of history.

results.title: No Handouts
results.overview: In a hyper-capitalistic future, rookie EMT Joanna Broz finds herself in a struggle between job security and an Innocent boy's life.

results.title: How to Divorce During the War
results.overview: On the eve of Russia's invasion of Ukraine, a high-flying executive tells her husband she wants a divorce, forcing the couple to navigate their bitter separation amid an escalating mid-life crisis and an unfolding regional refugee emergency.

results.title: Era Uma Vez Minha 1ª Vez
results.overview: The first time rarely goes the way we expect—especially when we expect too much. Teresa, Clara, Tuca, and Patty are in a hurry and make a pact: lose their virginity before high school prom night. They just forgot one tiny detail: everyone moves at their own pace.

results.title: Kameleon 3
results.overview: When the inseparable twins Hielke and Sietse Klinkhamer discover that a mysterious criminal is plotting an attack on the world-famous Ir. D.F. Wouda Pumping Station, a nerve-wracking race against time begins.

results.title: Double Happiness
results.overview: Tim Kao, the meticulous head chef of a five-star hotel in Taiwan, is set to marry his Hong Kong fiance Daisy Wu. But Tim’s divorced parents refuse to attend the same ceremony, and each insists on hosting their own. To complicate things further, the Feng Shui master chooses the same auspicious date for both events. Tim, Daisy, their wedding planner Regina, and the best man Tsai must orchestrate two weddings simultaneously in the same hotel, without either parent finding out. Surrounded by a strict father, a demanding mother, and a cast of sharp-tongued relatives, Tim must confront the traumas of his upbringing and ask himself: is he truly ready to start a new family of his own?

results.title: Spirits Talk
results.overview: A grieving woman’s reality and memories begin to blur as her adoptive mother, Mother Nikki, reaches out to her from the spirit realm. She must speak to her mother one last time—or risk losing the ability to love herself and others.

results.title: Chand Mera Dil
results.overview: Aarav and Chandni's passionate college romance is struck by adulthood far too soon, forcing the two young lovers to balance their ambitions with responsibility and realize the evolved meaning of love.

results.title: El mal
results.overview: “El mal is basically a suspense story, where the audience senses that something disturbing is going to happen, but doesn't know how or when. But it also aims to get the viewer to question their own certainties, their capacity to love and to accept their own dark side.”

results.title: Konfuzja
results.overview: Igor is a Warsaw taxi driver who makes money by transporting drug deliveries for Butcher - a local gangster. Apart from his friend Darek, Igor has no friends. He is lonely, quiet and reserved. He makes friends with 10-year-old Julia, the daughter of Ewa, a dealer he knows, whom he sometimes takes to school. Children go missing in the area, and Igor begins to be observed by the investigating commissioner Zadra. Everything becomes more complicated when Igor is tasked with transporting two mysterious suitcases, and Ewa is found dead.

results.title: Ni contigo ni sin mí
results.overview: Ernesto's wife has just left him. He decides to spend his birthday at his beach house with his best friend, only to discover that his ex-wife is now his neighbour's new girlfriend.

results.title: Hamlet
results.overview: When Hamlet returns for his father’s funeral, he is stunned to discover his uncle Claudius is marrying his newly widowed mother. Visited by his father’s ghost, Hamlet learns his brutal murder was at the hands of Claudius and spirals into a quest for vengeance that exposes the rot at the heart of the family’s empire and threatens his own sanity.

results.title: Remanence: A Voltage Cosmic Horror
results.overview: Two paramedics in Novo Hamburgo stumble upon treasure in an old basement. They accidentally open a dimensional portal, unleashing The Engineer, a creature who can travel between multiverses, now determined to reclaim its gold at any cost.
